ev-space-2.description: Tight within-group gap: label to value.

ev-space-6.description: Between groups (low end); grid column gutter.

ev-space-16.description: True chapter break only. Never the default page-stack gap.

ev-radius.description: The few surfaces that earn one: a contained calculator, a contrast band.

ev-t-display.description: Only the single page-defining statement, when scale is earned. Max 20ch.

ev-t-title.description: The normal page title (h1). Says what happened or what decision is needed. Max 24ch.

ev-t-h24.description: Major section turns (h2). Sentence case, states the claim.

ev-t-lede.description: One short orientation passage under the title, in text-secondary. Max 68ch.

ev-t-body.description: Reading prose, 60 to 68 characters per line.

ev-t-small.description: Captions, stat labels, button text (at weight 500), tables in compact density.

ev-t-label.description: Field labels and helper text, in text-secondary.

ev-t-meta.description: Masthead metadata and footer line. Tabular numerals.

ev-value-lead.description: A decisive stat or calculator result. Tabular numerals. Peers share this exact role.

ev-t-code.description: Only code, commands, paths, raw tokens, timestamps and short IDs. Set only the identifier in mono, never the whole sentence or table.

ev-background-100.description: Page canvas. The report is normally one continuous canvas on this color.

ev-background-200.description: Secondary surface: bar tracks, disabled fields. Never a card fill for ordinary sections.

ev-gray-100.description: Lowest gray step. Rarely used directly; prefer alpha grays over surfaces.

ev-gray-500.description: Decorative rules only; too light for text.

ev-gray-600.description: Disabled marks; too light for body text.

ev-gray-700.description: Placeholder-level marks. Below 4.5:1 on canvas, so never body text.

ev-gray-800.description: Tertiary chart series (chart-3/6). Use only at 18px+ or for marks.

ev-gray-900.description: Secondary text on background-100 and background-200 (text-secondary). Chart series 2.

ev-gray-1000.description: Primary text, headings, primary button fill, chart series 1.

ev-gray-alpha-400.description: Default borders for controls and table rules (border-default).

ev-blue-100.description: Blue scale. Tinted background for a state that needs a surface. Color only when it adds meaning to state, action or data, paired with a non-color cue.

ev-blue-400.description: Blue scale. Tinted border or fill for a state. Color only when it adds meaning to state, action or data, paired with a non-color cue.

ev-blue-700.description: Blue scale. Solid state fill. Color only when it adds meaning to state, action or data, paired with a non-color cue.

ev-blue-900.description: Blue scale. State text and marks on canvas. Color only when it adds meaning to state, action or data, paired with a non-color cue.

ev-blue-1000.description: Blue scale. Highest-contrast state text. Color only when it adds meaning to state, action or data, paired with a non-color cue.

ev-red-100.description: Red scale. Tinted background for a state that needs a surface. Color only when it adds meaning to state, action or data, paired with a non-color cue.

ev-red-900.description: Red scale. State text and marks on canvas. Color only when it adds meaning to state, action or data, paired with a non-color cue.

ev-red-1000.description: Red scale. Highest-contrast state text. Color only when it adds meaning to state, action or data, paired with a non-color cue.

ev-amber-100.description: Amber scale. Tinted background for a state that needs a surface. Color only when it adds meaning to state, action or data, paired with a non-color cue.

ev-amber-400.description: Amber scale. Tinted border or fill for a state. Color only when it adds meaning to state, action or data, paired with a non-color cue.

ev-amber-700.description: Amber scale. Solid state fill. Color only when it adds meaning to state, action or data, paired with a non-color cue.

ev-amber-900.description: Amber scale. State text and marks on canvas. Color only when it adds meaning to state, action or data, paired with a non-color cue.

ev-amber-1000.description: Amber scale. Highest-contrast state text. Color only when it adds meaning to state, action or data, paired with a non-color cue.

ev-green-100.description: Green scale. Tinted background for a state that needs a surface. Color only when it adds meaning to state, action or data, paired with a non-color cue.

ev-green-400.description: Green scale. Tinted border or fill for a state. Color only when it adds meaning to state, action or data, paired with a non-color cue.

ev-green-700.description: Green scale. Solid state fill. Color only when it adds meaning to state, action or data, paired with a non-color cue.

ev-green-900.description: Green scale. State text and marks on canvas. Color only when it adds meaning to state, action or data, paired with a non-color cue.

ev-green-1000.description: Green scale. Highest-contrast state text. Color only when it adds meaning to state, action or data, paired with a non-color cue.

ev-surface-secondary.description: Secondary surface for bar tracks and disabled states.

ev-surface-contrast.description: The only contrast field: Band with inverse. Same in both themes. Use the Band component instead of painting this surface yourself.

ev-text-primary.description: Body copy, headings, values on surface-primary and surface-secondary.

ev-text-secondary.description: Labels, captions, metadata, helper text on surface-primary and surface-secondary. Never tiny gray prose.

ev-border-subtle.description: Table row rules and quiet separators. Prefer spacing first.

ev-border-strong.description: Hovered input border, table header rule.

ev-focus.description: Focus ring, 2px solid, on every interactive element.

ev-color-info.description: Informational state. Pair with a word or icon.

ev-color-success.description: Success state. Never to make a favorable number green.

ev-color-warning.description: Warning state. Pair with a word.

ev-color-error.description: Error text and invalid field borders.

ev-chart-2.description: Chart series 2: supporting or reference series.

ev-chart-4.description: Chart series 4 (repeats 1; distinguish with dash or direct label).

ev-chart-5.description: Chart series 5 (repeats 2; distinguish with dash or direct label).

ev-chart-6.description: Chart series 6 (repeats 3; distinguish with dash or direct label).
